ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have interest in an instructor’s research should reach out to them directly about the possibility of working with them and initiating registration in this course. Upon receiving approvable from the faculty member, the student will need to complete an Independent Study Form which can be found here: https://go.illinois.edu/IndependentStudy. Students must complete all sections of the form before it can be submitted for review by their participating instructor. Once the form has been reviewed and approved by the department, the student will receive further registration information from the College of Media Student Services Center.
